name: Planetary Vitals
summary:
Turn your space into a planetary observatory. Planetary Vitals brings published science and mission data into views you can pick up, arrange and explore.

EXPLORE EARTH
Follow wind at different atmospheric levels. Compare temperature, humidity and satellite maps on a globe or terrain tile. Stack ten installed July land-temperature maps from 2016–2025, with dates and sources visible.
